item.title: Version 1.5.2
item.changes: Camera Raw Shadows now matches Photoshop: dark areas lift the way they do there Open a RAW file straight into the Camera Raw Filter from the import dialog Reset any Camera Raw section from its header Clear any keyboard shortcut, or give one to CMYK Proof Colors and Gamut Warning Shortcuts on the Delete key can now be changed Custom keyboard shortcuts are kept when the app updates Update notices always show at full width
